_note: B-34. Requester authorization check on the client's authorized-contacts list (fixtures/psa/contacts-authorized.json). Mock only; no real PSA is called. Evidence for the verification record; it never sets verification.

levers.name: contact.check
levers.description: Answer whether a named requester may request a given change type for this client, from the client's own authorized-contacts list only. Evidence for the approval page; it never verifies the requester.

requester.description: Email address the request came from or names, e.g. sam.patel@contosodental.example

change_type.description: The kind of change being requested

impact.L1: A stranger cannot get an account or access in someone else's name; a real person not yet listed is sent to their primary contact, not refused for good.
impact.L2: The client decides who may ask for changes in its name, and an unknown requester goes back to the client's primary contact instead of being guessed at.
impact.L3: The technician gets a fast, repeatable answer, kept as evidence beside the callback; verification stays a human act, so the check is not a rubber stamp.
impact.L4: Only the client's own list is read, so one office's contacts are never visible to, or used for, another's.
